notes: Property "Asian Paints WebSDK" (https://assets.adobedtm.com/ef0f7eb243a4/50bf6aad1917/launch-aa461fb6c86d.min.js): extensions Core, Adobe Client Data Layer, Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK.
Rule events: Library Loaded, Data Pushed, Data Layer Computed State, Query String Parameter; actions: Send event, Update variable, Custom Code.

Rules start on the `pageLoad` push to `adobeDataLayer` (rule "XDM : data pushed : 50 : Page Load" sends `web.webpagedetails.pageViews` on the Launch-managed `alloy` instance) — without that push the library loads and sends nothing.
Interaction rules listen for one `adobeDataLayer` event each (custom_cta_click, scroll_depth, form_start/form_submit, login, chat, …); the pushes come from the blocks — see the tagging plan.
On the source it is loaded by /eds/scripts/third-party-pixels.js (fireGTM) right after a `dataLayer` `page_view` push (`page_location`, `page_referrer`, `page_title`).
